title: Correctness of the SAT Reduction
statement: For every Boolean word $x$, including words that do not encode a well-formed formula, $x$ belongs to $\mathrm{SAT}$ if and only if its image under the string-level reduction belongs to $\mathrm{SAT3}$.
replaced:
For every binary string $x$ — with no well-formedness hypothesis — $x$ belongs to
$\mathrm{SAT}$ if and only if the image of $x$ under the string-level reduction
belongs to $\mathrm{3SAT}$.
